text: 诺曼摇醒了你，目光投向树林。“有声音！”他嘶声说道，“西尔维娅不见了！”
你立刻跳起来，披上外套，从地上拿起步枪。尽管天还没亮多久，亚寒带的黎明已经到来。
你搜查周围地面，发现了绑走西尔维娅者的足迹。它们和你预想的不同——是大得惊人的赤脚印。
若要循着足迹追踪，前往 128。若要认定西尔维娅已失踪，并设法保护诺曼，前往 279。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 82
text: Norman shakes you awake, staring out to the trees. “There was a noise!” he hisses. “Sylvia’s gone!”
You spring to your feet, throw on your jacket, and pick up your rifle from the ground. Despite the small hours of the morning, the subarctic dawn is breaking.
A search of the surrounding ground turns up the tracks of Sylvia’s abductors. They are not quite what you expect— oversized, bare feet.
To follow the tracks, go to 128. To give Sylvia up for lost and try to save Norman, go to 279.
